Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: Then God said to Moses: 'Command the imāms, the sons of Aaron, and say to them: Let no one among you become impure through a dead person of his people —
translations.2: except for his next of kin, who is close to him: his mother and his father, and his son and his daughter and his brother,
translations.3: and his virgin sister who is closest to him — she who has not yet become belonging to a man; for her he shall become impure, as is obligatory.
translations.4: But he shall not become impure through a person of consequence from his people, as that would debase him.
translations.5: They shall not pluck a plucking from the hair of their heads, nor shall they shave the corners of their beards, nor shall they scratch a scratch upon their bodies.
translations.6: And they shall be consecrated to their Lord, and shall not debase the name of their Lord — for, inasmuch as they are those who offer the offerings of God their Lord continually, they shall be consecrated.
translations.7: With a wanton and debased woman they shall not marry, and with a woman divorced from her husband they shall not marry — for every one of them is consecrated to his Lord.
translations.8: And you shall consecrate him, as is obligatory — for he offers the offering of your Lord the Eternal; he shall therefore be consecrated to you, even as I, God, consecrate you.
translations.9: And whichever daughter of a man who is an imām has debased herself and acted wantonly — she has brought public disgrace upon her father; she shall be burned with fire.
translations.10: And the great imām among his brothers, upon whose head the anointing oil is poured and whose obligation is fulfilled by the wearing of the vestments — he shall not dishevel his head, nor shall he tear his garments.
translations.11: Over any dead person he shall not enter; even for his father and his mother he shall not become impure.
translations.12: And from the sanctuary he shall not go out after them, nor shall he debase the consecration of his Lord — for, inasmuch as the crown of his Lord's anointing oil is upon him, I, God, have honored him.
translations.13: And he — he shall marry none but a virgin woman.
translations.14: As for a widow, or a divorced woman, or a debased woman, or a wanton woman — he shall not marry any of these; only a virgin woman from his people shall he marry.
translations.15: And he shall not debase his offspring through any other than her from his people — for I, God, consecrate him.'
translations.16: Then God spoke to Moses in speech.
translations.17: 'Command Aaron and say to him: Any man from your offspring, throughout their generations, in whom there is a blemish — he shall not come forward to offer the offering of his Lord.
translations.18: For every man in whom there is a blemish shall not come forward. Among such: the blind and the lame, and one with a cleft nose and one who limps,
translations.19: or a man in whom there is a broken leg or a broken arm,
translations.20: or a hunchback, or one of dim sight, or one with a cataract in his eye, or in whom there is mange or thick scaling of the head, or one with a crushed testicle —
translations.21: so too every man in whom there is a blemish, from the offspring of Aaron the imām: he shall not come forward to offer the offering of God; and whatever that blemish be in him, the offering of his Lord he shall not come forward to offer.
translations.22: However, the provision of his Lord — from the choicest of the holy things and from the general portions thereof — he may eat.
translations.23: But into the curtain he shall not enter, and to the altar he shall not come forward, since there is a blemish in him; and he shall not debase My sacred things — for I, God, consecrate them.'
translations.24: And Moses commanded thereby Aaron and his sons, and the rest of the sons of Israel.
